panels.title: Conso. HP

targets.rawSql:
WITH x AS (
  SELECT
    (c.date + c.interval_start::time) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris' AS ts,
    ((c.date + c.interval_start::time) - interval '6 hours')::date AS tempo_date,
    (c.interval_start::time >= '22:00' OR c.interval_start::time < '06:00') AS is_hc,
    c.value AS w,
    c.value / 2000.0 AS kwh
  FROM consumption_data c
  WHERE c.granularity = 'detailed' AND c.usage_point_id = '$pdl' AND c.date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date
)
SELECT SUM(kwh) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_hc) AS "HP" FROM x

panels.title: Coût Tempo (hors abonnement)

targets.rawSql:
WITH x AS (
  SELECT
    (c.date + c.interval_start::time) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris' AS ts,
    ((c.date + c.interval_start::time) - interval '6 hours')::date AS tempo_date,
    (c.interval_start::time >= '22:00' OR c.interval_start::time < '06:00') AS is_hc,
    c.value AS w,
    c.value / 2000.0 AS kwh
  FROM consumption_data c
  WHERE c.granularity = 'detailed' AND c.usage_point_id = '$pdl' AND extract(year FROM c.date) = extract(year FROM current_date) - 0
), p AS (
  SELECT x.*, t.color, o.subscription_price AS abo,
    CASE t.color
      WHEN 'BLUE'  THEN CASE WHEN x.is_hc THEN o.tempo_blue_hc  ELSE o.tempo_blue_hp  END
      WHEN 'WHITE' THEN CASE WHEN x.is_hc THEN o.tempo_white_hc ELSE o.tempo_white_hp END
      WHEN 'RED'   THEN CASE WHEN x.is_hc THEN o.tempo_red_hc   ELSE o.tempo_red_hp   END
    END AS prix
  FROM x
  LEFT JOIN tempo_days t ON t.id = to_char(x.tempo_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT eo.* FROM energy_offers eo
    JOIN energy_providers ep ON ep.id = eo.provider_id
    WHERE eo.offer_type = 'TEMPO' AND eo.power_kva = $puissance_kva AND ep.name ILIKE '%EDF%'
    ORDER BY (eo.valid_from <= x.ts) DESC, abs(extract(epoch FROM eo.valid_from - x.ts))
    LIMIT 1
  ) o ON true
)
SELECT SUM(kwh * prix) AS "Coût" FROM p

panels.description: Tarif EDF Tempo en vigueur à chaque date, calculé à la demi-heure. Demi-heures disponibles depuis le 17/09/2024 : années antérieures partielles ou vides.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT lpad(m::text, 2, '0') || ' ' || (ARRAY['Janvier','Février','Mars','Avril','Mai','Juin','Juillet','Août','Septembre','Octobre','Novembre','Décembre'])[m] AS "Mois", SUM(v) / 1000.0 AS "Consommation"
FROM (SELECT extract(month FROM c.date)::int AS m, c.value AS v FROM consumption_data c
      WHERE c.granularity = 'daily' AND c.usage_point_id = '$pdl' AND extract(year FROM c.date) = extract(year FROM current_date) - 0) s
GROUP BY m ORDER BY m

SELECT (SUM(c.value) - SUM(b.value))::float / NULLIF(SUM(b.value), 0) AS "Évolution"
FROM consumption_data c
JOIN consumption_data b
  ON b.usage_point_id = c.usage_point_id AND b.granularity = 'daily'
 AND b.date = (c.date - interval '1 year')::date
WHERE c.granularity = 'daily' AND c.usage_point_id = '$pdl' AND extract(year FROM c.date) = extract(year FROM current_date) - 0

panels.title: Energie consommée par jour - en kWh - 12 derniers mois

targets.rawSql:
WITH x AS (
  SELECT
    (c.date + c.interval_start::time) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris' AS ts,
    ((c.date + c.interval_start::time) - interval '6 hours')::date AS tempo_date,
    (c.interval_start::time >= '22:00' OR c.interval_start::time < '06:00') AS is_hc,
    c.value AS w,
    c.value / 2000.0 AS kwh
  FROM consumption_data c
  WHERE c.granularity = 'detailed' AND c.usage_point_id = '$pdl' AND c.date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date
)
SELECT ((ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris' AS time,
  SUM(kwh) FILTER (WHERE is_hc) AS "HC",
  SUM(kwh) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_hc) AS "HP"
FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
